map.火候控制指南：汇总中餐旺火、中火、小火、微火四档火力的火焰特征与适用烹饪方式，纯: Heat-control guide: summarizes the flame traits and suitable cooking methods of four Chinese-cooking heat levels — high, medium, low, simmer — pure front-end local lookup, mastering the "match fire to dish" heat skill.
map.提示：火候核心是\"看菜下火\"，爆炒要旺火速成，炖煮要小火慢煨。火候与油温、食: Tip: the core of heat is "match fire to dish" — flash-fry needs high heat for quick finish, braise needs low heat slow simmer. Heat must pair with oil temperature and ingredient thickness to make a good dish.
map.爆炒、汆烫、炝锅用旺火，锁住水分保脆嫩，强调\"锅气\"。: Flash-fry, blanch, fragrance-pop use high heat to lock moisture and keep crisp-tender, emphasizing "wok hei" (breath of the wok).
map.煎、贴、干煸用中火，外焦里嫩色泽好，不易糊底。: Pan-fry, stick-fry, dry-fry use medium heat for crisp outside tender inside with good color, less likely to scorch.
map.炖、焖、煨、卤用小火，入味软烂汤醇厚，切忌急火。: Braise, simmer, stew, red-cook use low heat for flavor penetration, soft tenderness and rich broth; never rush with high heat.
map.煲汤收尾、保温、熬酱用微火，长时间慢出味。: Soup finishing, keep-warm, sauce reduction use simmer for long slow flavor release.
map.爆炒（大火）适合绿叶菜、腰花等易熟食材，快速出锅保脆嫩保色；火力不足会出水变焖。: Flash-fry (high heat) suits leafy greens, kidney etc. quick-cooking ingredients; out fast to keep crisp-tender and color; insufficient heat makes them water-logged and steamed.
map.煎（中火）鱼、牛排类需热锅温油、定型后再翻，避免粘皮破碎；小火慢煎则用于蛋饺、糍: Pan-fry (medium) fish, steak need hot-pan-then-warm-oil, shape-set before flipping to avoid skin sticking and breaking; low slow fry for egg dumplings, glutinous cakes.
map.炖、煨、卤（小火/微火）长时间加热使肉质酥烂、汤汁醇厚，大火易糊底，需先大火煮沸: Braise, stew, red-cook (low / simmer) long heating makes meat tender and broth rich; high heat scorches the bottom; first boil on high then turn to low.
map.锅烧至冒烟下油（大火），青菜入锅快翻 30–60 秒至塌软断生即出锅，保翠绿脆嫩: Heat the wok until smoking, add oil (high heat), greens in, quick-toss 30–60 seconds until wilted and just done, out of the pan to keep emerald green and crisp-tender; medium-heat long stir makes them water out, yellow and soft.
map.大火和中火怎么判断？: How to tell high from medium heat?
map.大火火焰窜出锅沿、蓝焰集中；中火火焰稳定在锅底、不外延；家用灶以火焰接触面与声音: High heat flame leaps past the wok rim, blue flame concentrated; medium heat flame stays at the wok bottom, not spreading out; home stove judges by flame contact area and sound (sizzle).
map.为什么炖肉要先大火后小火？: Why braise meat high first then low?
map.大火煮沸去浮沫、定味，小火慢炖让胶原脂肪转化、肉质酥烂且汤清不浑，久大火则易糊底: High heat boils off foam and sets flavor; low slow braise turns collagen and fat, meat tender and broth clear not cloudy; long high heat scorches bottom and dries meat.
map.有关。煎鱼煎蛋需「热锅凉油」中火、食材表面干爽再下；火太急或锅不够热都易粘，可先: Yes. Pan-frying fish and egg needs "hot-pan-cool-oil" medium heat, ingredient surface dry before adding; too-eager fire or not-hot-enough wok both stick; you can heat the wok first then pour oil.
